gdpr.export: Hype Market: every call the member made, their season totals and today's spending.
gdpr.delete: Hype Market: the member's calls, season totals and spending are deleted. Markets on their discussions stay, without an author.

page.title: Hype Market
page.description: Back the new discussions you think will take off. Free hype every day, prices that follow real conversation, and a monthly leaderboard.
page.lead: Spot the next big discussion early. Back it with today's free hype, and earn more the more it grows.
page.empty_hot: No open markets right now. Every new discussion opens one, so check back soon.

wallet.guest: Every member gets free hype every day to back the discussions they think will take off. No real money, nothing to buy.

card.gone: A discussion you can't see anymore
card.needs_people: Pays once {n} more people join in

bar.label: Hype Market for this discussion
bar.yours: Your discussion. Others can back it, you can't.
bar.call_off_confirm: Call off this market? Every backer gets their hype back and nobody profits. This can't be undone.
bar.called_off: Market called off. Every stake comes back flat.

back.title: Back this discussion
back.left: {left} of {allowance} hype left today, {backs} backs left. Refills in {time}.
back.rule_settles: Settles in {time}. You earn in proportion to how much it grows after now, so early calls pay most.
back.rule_safe: You can't lose hype. A quiet discussion pays your stake back.
back.rule_loss: If it stays quiet you lose {percent}% of your stake. It has to grow {x}× to break even.
back.rule_people: It only pays once at least {n} different members join the conversation.
back.rule_own: Your own replies and likes won't count toward it, and neither will other backers'.
back.no_hype: You've used today's hype. It refills in {time}.
back.no_backs: You've used today's backs. They refill in {time}.

portfolio.open: {count, plural, =0 {Open calls} one {# open call} other {# open calls}}
portfolio.empty_open: No open calls. Find a discussion on the rise in Hottest and back it.
portfolio.empty_settled: Nothing has settled yet. Calls settle a few days after the discussion starts.

board.how_price: A discussion's price climbs as different members reply and like posts in it, with diminishing returns.
board.how_pay: When a market settles, every backer gets their stake times how much the price grew after they backed it, up to 10×.
board.how_loss: On this forum a call that stays quiet loses {percent}% of its stake, so a discussion has to grow {x}× to break even.
board.how_fair: The author, the backers and brand-new accounts don't move the price, and the same friends can only lift your calls a few times a season.
board.how_rank: Members are ranked by season profit. Seasons reset every month.
board.empty: Nobody has a settled call this season yet.

notification.flat: Your hype call didn't pay off
notification.preference_paid: Someone's discussion I backed took off and paid out
notification.preference_flat: A discussion I backed didn't pay off or was called off

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.hype_own_discussion: You can't back your own discussion.
errors.hype_closed: Backing has closed on this discussion.
errors.hype_bad_stake: Choose an amount between the minimum and maximum stake.
errors.hype_allowance: You don't have that much hype left today.
errors.hype_daily_backs: You've used all of today's backs.

settings.nav: Show Hype Market in the sidebar
settings.daily_allowance_help: Free hype every member gets each day (UTC). Unused hype doesn't carry over.
settings.min_stake_help: The least hype a member can put on one discussion.
settings.max_stake_help: The most hype a member can put on one discussion. Never more than the daily hype.
settings.max_backs_help: How many discussions one member can back in a day.
settings.backing_hours: Hours a discussion can be backed
settings.backing_hours_help: Backing closes this many hours after a discussion starts.
settings.window_hours_help: Markets settle this many hours after the discussion starts. Engagement after that doesn't count.
settings.min_account_days_help: Replies and likes from accounts younger than this (when they posted) don't move prices.
settings.min_posts_help: Members with fewer posts than this don't move prices.
settings.min_participants_help: A market pays out only when at least this many different members (not the author or backers) replied.
settings.loss_percent_help: 0 means nobody ever loses hype: a quiet discussion pays the stake back. Above 0, a call loses this share of its stake if the discussion stays flat, and has to grow past it to profit (50% = break even at 1.5×). Calls already made keep the rate they were made with.
settings.season_mode_help: Monthly seasons start fresh on the first of every month. Manual seasons run until you end them below.

season.heading: Season
season.no_leaders: Nobody has a settled call this season yet.
season.end_help: The leaderboard starts fresh. Calls still open keep counting toward the season they were made in.
season.confirm: End this season and start the next one? This can't be undone.
season.tick_ok: The scheduler last ran {minutes} min ago. Markets are being priced and settled.
season.tick_late: The scheduler last ran {minutes} min ago. Markets only move and settle while it runs (php flarum schedule:run every minute).
season.tick_never: The scheduler hasn't run yet. Markets only move and settle while it runs: add php flarum schedule:run to cron, every minute.
